prompts: Create one production-ready transparent-background game sprite: a small medieval stone-foundation timber cottage with a warm muted brown shingle gable roof, wooden door and two small windows. Single isolated building, no ground tile, no grass, no scenery, no text, no borders, no cast shadow beyond its footprint. Authentic late-1990s/early-2000s isometric RPG pre-rendered sprite aesthetic, finely detailed earthy stone and wood, muted natural palette, soft light from upper left. Orthographic camera azimuth 45 degrees, looking down at approximately 35.3 degrees; ground-plane square footprint projects as a diamond with width:height 1.414:1 (NOT typical flattened 2:1). Both visible sides balanced. Fully visible roof and foundation, no cropping, centered horizontally, generous transparent margin. Small square 2x2 tile footprint. Actual transparent alpha background. Render large enough for a clean editable master, building fills most of image.

Create one production-ready transparent-background game sprite: a small medieval square stone watchtower, two storeys, crenellated top, narrow arrow windows and a dark timber ground-floor door. Single isolated building, no ground tile, no grass, no scenery, no text, no borders, no cast shadow beyond its footprint. Authentic late-1990s/early-2000s isometric RPG pre-rendered sprite aesthetic, finely detailed earthy gray-beige stone, muted natural palette, soft light from upper left. Orthographic camera azimuth 45 degrees, looking down at approximately 35.3 degrees; ground-plane square footprint projects as a diamond with width:height 1.414:1 (NOT typical flattened 2:1). Both visible sides balanced. Fully visible crenellations and foundation, no cropping, centered horizontally, generous transparent margin. Compact square single-tile footprint. Actual transparent alpha background. Render large enough for a clean editable master, building fills most of image.
